skill.name: brainstorming
skill.description: Guides collaborative brainstorming for feature ideas, requirements, trade-offs, and implementation-ready design documents.
skill.summary: Plan feature ideas through focused questions, option trade-offs, and validated design documentation.
skill.author: obra

security_audit.summary: The only static finding is a false positive caused by Markdown inline code formatting on SKILL.md line 38. No prompt injection, exfiltration intent, or unsafe executable code was found in the reviewed skill file.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 38 contains Markdown inline code for a documentation path, not executable Ruby or shell syntax. The reviewed skill is prompt-only and includes no runnable scripts.

content.value_statement: Feature ideas often move to implementation before goals and constraints are clear. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through questions, trade-offs, and validated design notes.
actual_capabilities: Reviews current project files, docs, and recent commits before proposing design direction.
Asks one focused question per message to refine goals, constraints, and success criteria.
Compares two or three approaches with trade-offs and a recommendation.
Presents architecture, components, data flow, errors, and testing in short validated sections.
Writes the approved design into a dated plan document.
limitations: Does not implement the feature by itself.
Requires user answers before it can refine ambiguous requirements.
May need project access to review files, docs, and commits.
Git commits are suggested as a workflow step, not automatic execution.

use_cases.title: Shape a New Product Feature
use_cases.description: Clarify goals, constraints, and success criteria before engineering work begins.

use_cases.title: Design a Code Change
use_cases.description: Compare implementation approaches and produce a concise design for review.

use_cases.title: Clarify User Experience Behavior
use_cases.description: Explore interaction options and validate expected behavior before UI changes.

prompt_templates.title: Explore a Simple Idea
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner planning for a small feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me brainstorm a small feature idea. Ask one question at a time until the goal and success criteria are clear.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Feature Approaches
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate planning with multiple possible solutions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Brainstorm approaches for this feature. Review the project context, compare two or three options, and recommend one with trade-offs.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Validated Design
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a design for this change. Cover architecture, components, data flow, error handling, and testing in short sections.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare an Implementation-Ready Plan
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a cross-system change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide a full brainstorming session for this system change. Validate each design section, resolve open questions, and prepare a dated plan document.

output_examples.input: We need a customer export feature.
output: Question: Which export format matters first, CSV or spreadsheet?
Recommended approach: start with a queued export flow for reliability.
Design section: include permissions, progress status, retention, and retry behavior.

output_examples.input: Our settings page needs a better notification workflow.
output: Option A: keep one page with grouped settings for faster edits.
Option B: split channels into tabs for clearer review.
Recommendation: use grouped settings first, then add tabs if volume grows.

output_examples.input: Plan a redesign of the onboarding flow.
output: Discovery focus: define activation, required steps, and drop-off risks.
Design section: map screens, state transitions, empty states, and recovery paths.
Validation step: confirm whether analytics events are required before implementation.

best_practices: Answer each question with concrete constraints, examples, and success criteria.
Review trade-offs before choosing a final direction.
Validate each design section before asking for implementation planning.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before the design has been validated.
Requesting many unrelated ideas in one brainstorming session.
Skipping project context when existing architecture affects the design.

faq.question: When should I use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it before feature work, behavior changes, components, or architecture decisions.

faq.question: Does it write code?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on requirements, options, design sections, and planning documents.

faq.question: Can it work with an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. It asks the assistant to inspect files, docs, and recent commits first.

faq.question: How does it handle unclear requirements?
faq.answer: It asks one focused question at a time until the goal and constraints are clear.

faq.question: What does the final output look like?
faq.answer: The expected output is a validated design document with architecture, data flow, errors, and tests.

faq.question: Is it safe for private repositories?
faq.answer: The skill has no executable code, but project review still depends on your assistant permissions.
